The '''Tuff1 Combat Jumpsuit''' was a light protective suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was designed to be worn under loose clothing. It was made with [[Trauma pad|padded]] sections in the knees, elbows and chest. Manufactured from a lightweight material that dried quickly, it was comfortable for use in long periods. The suit also had various straps and rings for attaching equipment. It was mostly for backup protection, and was often worn under other forms of armor.

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] wore these suits on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] while trying to discover what the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had done to the planet.
